Done. The merge succeeded on the first execution.

**What I did**
- Wrote `out/T4/solution.py` using safetensors and torch only. It loads the three checkpoints, verifies identical name sets and shapes/dtypes, and checks with bit-exact equality that every non-MLP tensor matches across base, ft1 and ft2, aborting otherwise.
- The 48 MLP tensors are selected by an anchored regex and asserted to number exactly 48. Each task vector is taken against the unmodified base and merged in float32 with lambda 0.4. All other tensors are copied from the base.
- The script asserts 48 merged and 160 output tensors, saves `out/T4/model.safetensors`, and re-opens it to confirm the key set.
- `out/T4/REPORT.md` holds the self-report. I skipped mergekit because its task-arithmetic mode has no shared-tensor precondition check and would merge every tensor, not just the MLP ones.

**Result**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Executions | 1 |
| Failed executions | 0 |
| Tensors merged | 48 |
| Output tensors | 160 |

Grading with `grade.py T4 --target gpt-2` was not run, since it is the experimenter's step.
